title: include inside an included file names a missing file
notes: An `include:` inside an included file. The path is resolved from the top-level program's directory, not from `sub/`, and the note says so -- the same note E-RUNTIME-002 carries for a nested `import:`. The trailing `note: included by prog.pdl:2:5` is the chain back to the include that ran `sub/a.pdl`.
